text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good news, my guinea pi—I mean,
Trainer. I'll be
gracing you with a
colleague soon.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's quite the cute critter too. If you
leave it be,
it'll run inside its wheel for
eternity.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Since you two are practically one and
the same,
perhaps I should have you
cohabitate as well? I
could put you both
in a cage and...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aaahahaha! Calm yourself, I was merely
joking.
Unfortunately, pets are not
allowed on campus!
